sm_top.sm: Tankers were damaged in the Strait of Hormuz amid Iranian military announcements.
An Iranian strike on an industrial site in Bahrain wounded two people, prompting condemnation from Saudi Arabia.
Polish investigators confirmed three Russian missiles breached Polish airspace on November 20.
Regional states condemned attacks on Bahrain and Saudi Arabia amid ongoing security threats.
A Russia-bound ship was attacked by a drone in the Gulf of Finland.
The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya Muslims, prompting mixed international reactions.
Russia launched massive missile and drone strikes targeting critical infrastructure and locations across Ukraine and Kyiv.
Ukrainian sea drones and a drone attack targeted ships in Benghazi port, reportedly sinking a Russian corvette and causing 10 injuries.
The Saudi-led coalition air defenses intercepted and destroyed ballistic missiles and drones launched by Houthi forces.
A Russian ballistic missile attack damaged the Northern Bridge in Kyiv.
The Saudi-led coalition launched airstrikes on Hodeidah amid Houthi threats to Red Sea ports.
Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island amid claims of air defense activity and US strikes on an air defense site.
A ballistic missile and drone attack on Kryvyi Rih killed two people and injured multiple others.
Iran claims a US drone was taken down near the Strait of Hormuz.
Turkey and Qatar signed a mutual defense agreement to strengthen their strategic alliance.
Bahrain reported an Iranian strike on an industrial site as tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz.
A Russian drone or missile strike on an apartment block in the Kyiv region killed three people and injured several others.
An explosion occurred at the Al-Hartha thermal power station in Basra, prompting urgent investigations.
A Russia-bound ship was attacked by a drone in the Gulf of Finland, with Finnish defense forces attributing the strike to Ukraine.
Airstrikes in Kordofan caused heavy civilian casualties and displacement.
Thirty-four suspected bandits were killed during a Haitian National Police operation in Martissant.
Russia launched a massive wave of drones and missiles across Ukraine, killing at least seven people in Kyiv.
A Russian drone strike on a five-story building in the Kharkiv region injured 11 people, including children.
Dashcam footage captures an explosion on a street in Lviv.
RSF-allied forces claim advances in Sudan's Blue Nile State, moving closer to the state capital.
The Yemeni army states 193 Houthis were neutralized across 854 military operations.
Ukrainian forces carried out Operation Bear Trap in the Kharkiv region, liberating 14 settlements.
President Zelenskyy reported that Russia launched approximately 2,700 drones and 165 missiles at Ukraine over the past week.
Israeli airstrikes and explosions were reported across southern Lebanon.
A US F-35 fighter jet declared an emergency over the Strait of Hormuz and diverted to a UAE base.
Russia launched 186 drones at Ukraine, with 161 intercepted by Ukrainian air defense.
Russian air defenses intercepted and destroyed 275 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions.
The IRGC claimed to have destroyed an American MQ-1 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz.
Russian air defense systems intercepted and destroyed 170 Ukrainian fixed-wing UAVs overnight over multiple regions and sea areas.
Russian MoD claimed strikes on Ukrainian energy and transport infrastructure, drone and uncrewed boat production sites, military airfields, and a high-level meeting.
Satellite imagery shows the Russian Merkury corvette sunk in Libya following an explosion.
Polish officials state that three objects that crashed in Poland were Russian cruise missiles.
35 Fulanis were killed in revenge attacks in Nigeria.
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs targeting the Dnipropetrovsk region.
Russian missile and drone barrage killed 2 people in Lviv.
